facts.text: Buffalo Grove’s flag features a fighting buffalo, green leaves, and gold bands, chosen during the first Buffalo Days festival in 1962.
The village’s first library began in a high‑school classroom in 1974 and moved to a permanent building at 4 Indian Creek Road in Lincolnshire in 1993.
The Buffalo Grove Symphonic Band celebrated 25 years with a special concert on May 9, marking a quarter‑century of music in the community.
Olympic figure skater Bradie Tennell trained most of her life at Twin Rinks in Buffalo Grove, earning a 2018 Olympic team bronze medal.
By 1899 downtown Buffalo Grove had grown to include the Firnbach Tavern and the Weidner General Store, signaling its shift from a farm town to a suburb.
The village’s first annual festival, Buffalo Days, debuted in 1962, establishing a tradition that continues to this day.
